title: A Parasite With A Title
paragraphs: to true leadership measures its success by the diminishing dependency of itsfollowers this is a very subtle statement read itcarefully write it down true leadership is measured as being successful when thedependency of its followers diminishes in other words the less they need youthe more effective you are so if you need people to need you and to always bewith you and to depend on you you are not a leader you are a parasite with atitle you're feeding on people
